title: 13 Project Ideas for Intermediate Python Developers
description: Try 13 Python project ideas for intermediate developers. Build web, GUI, and command-line apps that challenge you and make you a better Pythonista.
summary: Learning the basics of Python is a wonderful experience. But the euphoria of just learning can be replaced by the hunger for hands-on projects.
takeaways: Get a printable one-page PDF of all 13 project ideas , with the tools to use, level-up challenges, and a worksheet to plan your next project: Intermediate Python Deep Dive Live Course: Want guidance as you level up from scripts to well-designed projects?

Real Python’s Intermediate Python Deep Dive live course works through advanced functions, Python’s object model, and clean design with an instructor and a small cohort, with feedback on the code you write.
The Importance of Building Projects Working on projects is vital to pushing your career as a Python developer forward.
